notes: Differences the parity harness reports as KNOWN instead of FAIL. Each entry names the deviation, quirk or open question of docs/modernization/legacy-parity-inventory.md that explains it, the table and the only columns allowed to differ, and the scenarios it applies to ('*': all).
An entry is evidence, not a decision: it stays until its deviation is reconciled by a focused slice, or the maintainer rules on it. A difference in any other column, or in row counts, still FAILs.

deviations.legacy: The browser client never sends field_Planificacion_activa (www/js/app/server/ancoragoh_server_planificaciones.js), so control/data/add/add_Planificacion.php reads an undefined key (a PHP warning) and stores activa = NULL, not the column default TRUE.
deviations.drupal: ancora_plan.active defaults to TRUE and is exported as TRUE. The engine never reads it.

deviations.legacy: ancoragoh.server.periodos.add and .update post cant_dias as field_Periodo_hora_inicial (www/js/app/server/ancoragoh_server_periodos.js:8,20), and the form posts the slot length in minutes (view/custom/form_periodo.tpl, TimeUtilsCommon::hour_to_number = h*60+m).
deviations.drupal: ancora_period.start_hour and slot_duration are hours, stored and exported as entered. Open question A-1 of the inventory; they feed only the displayed hours and the real-date restrictions, not the placement of one period.
